title: business opportunities - u.s. embassy to barbados, antigua and barbuda, dominica, grenada, saint kitts and nevis, saint lucia, and saint vincent and the grenadines
paragraphs: welcome to the procurement section of the general services office.  on this page, you will be able to find solicitations issued by the united states embassy to barbados, the eastern caribbean, and the oecs for the acquisition of commodities and/or services.
